Interface RingElement<T>

All Known Implementing Classes:
Matrix, Polynomial, ZModElement
public interface RingElement<T>
Common operations for a ring element whose concrete type is T. Implementations must obey the ring laws and return results without changing operands. The interface specifies operations, but cannot enforce the mathematical laws. Implementations used as coefficients must compare values with equals so that structures can recognize their zero element. Implementations with nested elements or ring configuration must override hasSameType to check those details recursively. Generic declarations cannot be recovered after erasure.

    • hasSameType

      default boolean hasSameType(Object other)
      Checks whether the other object has the same concrete class. Classes with nested elements or ring configuration must extend this check without comparing element values, matrix dimensions, or polynomial degrees.
      Parameters:
      other - the object to check
      Returns:
      true for the same concrete class, false for null or another class
